title: Delivery planning
turns: Is everybody here?
Almost.
We are holding the launch until the customer records finish copying into the new database. Releasing earlier would strand the old accounts.
The status page will stay green during the copy.
Who is checking the totals?
Mira will reconcile the row counts on Friday.

title: Dispatch design
turns: My screen is back.
Good.
The job and its schedule row must commit together. A rollback must remove both or a worker might run a cancelled delivery.
Right.
We will use the existing SQL transaction rather than call a separate queue service.

title: Field visit
turns: Morning.
I saw the invitation.
We talked about taking the ferry to the survey site. The crossing is shorter than the drive.
Tickets are still estimates. Nobody has submitted a budget request.
Bring the spare instrument batteries.

title: Image operations
turns: One more thing before lunch.
What happens if the camera is busy?
Postpone the firmware update until the observation ends. Interrupting a long exposure loses the entire frame.
Power cycling clears the cached clock settings.
The maintenance window starts at midnight.

title: Museum collection
turns: Thanks for making the time.
I have the notebook.
The paper maps curl when the display gets damp. Keep the relative humidity below fifty percent in the case.
The new alarm sends a text to the conservator.
The paintings are in a different gallery.

title: Bakery trials
turns: Can you hear me?
Yes, carry on.
The dough was tearing during shaping because it was too cold. Let it warm on the bench before stretching.
The rye loaf uses a different starter.
Oven two has a repaired thermostat.

title: Trail stewardship
turns: Just got back.
Go ahead.
Hikers keep losing the path at the creek crossing. Put orange markers on the far bank so the route is visible from the water.
We can borrow the post driver.
We discussed building a footbridge but have no construction date.

title: Freight incident
turns: That makes sense.
Which crates?
The glass broke because the crates slid on the truck floor. Add rubber mats under the pallets before the next shipment.
The carriers agreed to take photographs at loading.
A quote for replacement shelving is still outstanding.

title: Terminal outage drill
turns: The lobby terminal must compare its battery clock with server time after the outage. Track the implementation in sample/clock#7.
